step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced and open the Agreement Document.

Extract data from the document using the Intelligent Discovery option and click Review Import Results. For more information on data extraction, see Extracting Agreement Data Using Intelligent Discovery.
In the Contracts pane, click Work tab and click Doc Clauses. The list of extracted doc clauses are displayed.
Select the incorrectly tagged doc clauses and click the more button(). The following menu options are displayed.

ul.li: Re-Mark: To re-mark the selected clause in the document.

step.cmd: Click Re-mark on the confirmation dialog that appears. This removes the incorrect doc clauses and creates a new doc clause as per the new marking.
